   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import seaborn as sns\n",
    "import sys\n",
    "sys.path.append('../src')\n",
    "from utils import basic_report, TARGET\n",
    "\n",
    "train_df = pd.read_csv('/content/train.csv')\n",
    "basic_report(train_df)\n",
    "train_df.head()"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "markdown",

   }
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "source": [
    "plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))\n",
    "\n",
    "sns.countplot(x=TARGET, data=train_df)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.title('Attrition Balance (Train Set)')\n",

    "plt.ylabel('Number of Employees')\n",
    "plt.savefig('attrition_balance.png', bbox_inches='tight')\n",
    "plt.show()"

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "source": [
    "# Attrition by key categorical features"
   ],
   "metadata": {
    "id": "6o_VcoS-CAa5"
   }
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "source": [
    "cat_features = [c for c in ['Department', 'JobRole', 'OverTime', 'MaritalStatus'] if c in train_df.columns]\n",
    "\n",
    "for col in cat_features:\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(8,4))\n",
    "    sns.countplot(x=col, hue=TARGET, data=train_df)\n",
    "    plt.title(f'Attrition by {col}')\n",
    "    plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
    "    plt.savefig(f'{col}_attrition.png', bbox_inches='tight')\n",
    "    plt.show()"
   ],

  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "source": [
    "df = train_df.copy()\n",
    "df[TARGET] = df[TARGET].map({'Yes': 1, 'No': 0})\n",
    "# Clean MonthlyIncome\n",
    "df[\"MonthlyIncome\"] = (df[\"MonthlyIncome\"] .astype(str) .str.replace(\"$\", \"\", regex=False) .str.replace(\",\", \"\", regex=False))\n",
    "df[\"MonthlyIncome\"] = pd.to_numeric(df[\"MonthlyIncome\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "cat_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=\"object\").columns\n",
    "df = pd.get_dummies(df, columns=cat_cols, drop_first=True)\n",
    "X_train = df.drop(columns=[TARGET])\n",
    "y_train = df[TARGET]\n",
    "X_train.head()"
   ],

   "cell_type": "code",
   "source": [
    "from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier\n",
    "import joblib\n",
    "model = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, random_state=42, class_weight='balanced')\n",
    "model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "joblib.dump(model, 'attrition_model.pkl')\n",
    "joblib.dump(list(X_train.columns), 'model_columns.pkl')\n",
    "print(\"Model saved successfully!\")"
   ],

   "source": [
    "importances = pd.Series(model.feature_importances_, index=X_train.columns).sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)\n",

    "importances.plot(kind='barh')\n",
    "plt.gca().invert_yaxis()\n",
    "plt.title('Top 10 Feature Importances')\n",

    "plt.show()"
